title: Idempotent agent finish and work release
description: Context: a 2h47m dabble-employee-app agent session made 300 CLI calls with 24 failures. Failure clusters: 117 read-only work show polls (~40% of all calls), 14 identical failed sync refresh retries, 6 vault init retries, 66 agent finish calls with only 2 standalone evidence records, 6 NOT_FOUND finish/release (ownership confusion), 1 CONFLICT claim, 2 POLICY_VIOLATION sprint closes. Design principle for this mission: every response (success or error) must carry enough state that the correct next action is derivable without another read, and the honest path (evidence, ownership, health) must be the path of least resistance. Problem: 66 agent finish calls for far fewer work items indicates retry churn; re-finishing closed work or re-releasing a released reservation currently errors with BOREAL_NOT_FOUND. Change: when the caller is the agent that owned the reservation and the work is already in the state the command would produce, return success with noop:true and the existing summary/closeout payload instead of an error. Genuine ownership violations (another agent owns it, work never existed) still error, now with the task-3 terminal payload. Where: finish/release handlers in apps/cli/src/commands.ts and the reservation lifecycle in packages/engine/src/runtime.ts; the ledger already records who closed what, so ownership history is derivable. Constraint: noop calls must not append duplicate ledger events.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-running agent finish by the same agent on already-closed work returns success with noop:true and the existing summary
work release on an already-released reservation by the former owner is a success noop
Noop paths append zero new ledger events (test asserts ledger line count unchanged)
